statement: Never infer success from nonempty tool_output, modified_output, absence of error text, or POST_TOOL_CALL stage alone.
Use only an explicit public current-event success value or source-proven success-only control flow.
For a trace route, uniquely bind the current ToolEvent and preserve name, args, ok, output, and order.
For a context-only route, guardrail context must contain prior ordered successful fs.read events with the official event schema.
Preserve source_access, source_success, protected_path, and raw_read_output as separate evidence fields.
Do not modify aicomp_sdk, create aicomp_sdk_exfil, or create implementation in this gate.
Predicate and breach remain independently recomputed and are not executed in this gate.
